subject: Pilot extension & alternative bundling options
messages:
From: Sam Lee <sam.lee@clearstream.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 4 Jul 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short pilot extension + credit conversion

Hey Jonas —

Thanks again for the help during our integration run this week. We hit a bunch of edge cases while stress-testing the streaming path and need an extra window to validate latency at scale. Two asks from our side:

1) Can Clearstream get a short time-boxed extension of the pilot (2–3 weeks) without re-negotiating the whole contract? Our PMs need to finish the replay jobs.
2) We have ~40 unused evaluation days from the original schedule. Would Redwood convert those into usable burst credits (for higher-throughput test runs) instead of losing them at the end of the pilot?

Attached: usage_snapshot_Q2.csv (daily token counts + percentile latency samples).

We want to avoid a long procurement cycle — if you can outline 2 quick options (extension vs credit swap) with pricing, that would be ideal. Happy to hop on a short call Monday.

Sam
Sam Lee
Head of ML Infra
Clearstream Analytics
pilot_ops@clearstream.com

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@clearstream.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: short pilot extension + credit conversion

Sam —

Appreciate the note and the data. We can do this without a full procurement loop. Two pragmatic options to keep things moving:

Option A — Time-box extension (21 days)
- 21 additional calendar days, same environment and model pin.
- One-time extension fee = 25% of a single sprint block (sprint block = 7 days of reserved inference capacity sized to your peak QPS).
- No change in SLA; existing telemetry/trace access remains.

Option B — Credit swap (convert unused days -> sprint credits)
- Convert the 40 unused days into 3 sprint credits (valid 90 days from execution).
- Each sprint credit can be consumed in burst mode up to 3x baseline QPS for short windows; no latency SLO during bursts, but will be routed to dedicated capacity where possible.
- One-time administrative fee = $0 for this conversion (we view it as a goodwill concession for the integration hiccups).

Attached is a short proposal PDF with the math and two example invoices (jonas_proposal_pilot_options.pdf).

Quick ask: looping Marissa and Priyom to confirm apparent flexibility on the extension fee and the credit validity window. If Clearstream prefers the extension we can generate an amendment and a DocuSign link for a quick signature.

I can be on a 20-minute call tomorrow 10–10:30 PT if that works.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RE: Request: short pilot extension + credit conversion

Quick internal –

Thanks for drafting the two options. My thoughts:
- Option B (credit swap) is easiest from a procurement perspective and reduces churn risk. We should offer it for free as proposed, but tweak the credit validity to 120 days to give their SREs breathing room.
- For Option A, can we sweeten the extension fee to 30% of a sprint block if the customer signs within 48 hours? That helps Jonas close and keeps the arithmetic simple.
- Confirm with finance: if we convert unused days into credits and they later convert credits to prepay capacity, we should track it against CB-4821 (deal) for proper revenue recognition. Laura, can you confirm the accounting treatment?

Also: legal will need a one-line amendment covering term and credit conversion. I can draft and run to counsel. Priyom, help with the SLA note (burst vs steady state).

Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations

Sam —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We talked internally and can move forward with the following consolidated offer:

Final offer (pick one):
1) 21-day extension (same environment) 
   - Promotional price: 30% of one sprint block if signed within 48 hours.
   - All telemetry, tracing, and model pins unchanged.
   - Amendment (one-page) attached; signing link below.

2) Credit conversion (recommended for speed)
   - We will convert your 40 unused days into 3 sprint credits, valid for 120 days from execution.
   - Credits support burst runs up to 3x baseline QPS; burst runs prioritized to dedicated pools where capacity allows.
   - No administrative fee.

Next steps:
- If you choose Option 1, click here to sign the amendment: https://docusign.com/4f3a8c-amendment (DocuSign).
- If you choose Option 2, reply with confirmation and I will issue the credits and update the deal record (CB-4821).
- I can join a short sync at 10:00 PT today to walk through the mechanics with your infra lead.

Attachment: pilot_amendment_v1.pdf (one-page amendment stub).
